info.prompt: A neon-drenched cyber-gothic cathedral interior where skeletal gold filigree arches pulse with bioluminescent cyan veins, casting long shadows across a void-black floor tiled with hexagonal panels glowing magenta at the edges—three adjacent tiles ignite into a frenzy of white-hot particles as a player’s skeletal hand hovers over them, their 2.0× multiplier badge burning like a saint’s halo above the score display while terminal text scrolls "DOMAIN LOCKED" in jagged hacker-font across the bottom third of the frame, the whole scene vibrating with bass-heavy subsonic tremors that make the dangling bone-chandeliers tremble.
